description:
"It’s called Yoo Se-jin." Lee Yeon disguises her status as a student at a prestigious university and works part-time as an extracurricular student. One day, he discovers that the new student he is going to teach is Seo Do-young, who has been bullying him at school. "Lee Yeon, are you good at acting?" Seo Do-young had a grudge against Lee-yeon, who is cold for the woman she likes, and uses her weakness to encourage her to continue tutoring in order to avoid studying abroad. But... "Can I solve the curiosity you mentioned?" Lee Yeon is indifferent both at home and at school.
